recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the published clarification with a small build-scope source cleanup; any future work to remove or constrain QuestionnaireResponse references in base Observation should be handled by a separate OO decision.
issue_request: FHIR-16140 was a Published OO change request with Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked how QuestionnaireResponse can be a member of Observation.hasMember and requested clarification with examples or removal. The accepted resolution pointed to the Glasgow QA example and said to add language that a system may calculate questionnaire answers or another resource into a final score or measurement represented as an Observation.
initial_application: The 2018-07-24 GF#16140 batch commit 2ebd7c6f7fc99b6938d5a223685af7907288d11c added the hasMember comment now carried in source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml. The 2021 source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 preserved that applied text in the current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Observation and QuestionnaireResponse active in the current build. The current Observation.hasMember targetProfile still includes QuestionnaireResponse and carries the issue's clarification. The Glasgow QA Observation example references QuestionnaireResponse/gcs through derivedFrom, and the referenced QuestionnaireResponse example exists. Later core issues FHIR-44836 and FHIR-48420 narrowed vital-signs profile references only; they do not reverse the base Observation decision.
reconciliation: Updated source/observation/observation-examples-header.xml, source/observation/list-Observation-examples.xml, and source/observation/observation-example-glasgow-qa.xml to replace obsolete QuestionnaireAnswer/related wording with QuestionnaireResponse/derived-from wording that matches the actual example. No base Observation reference targets or cardinalities were changed.
source_changes: source/observation/observation-examples-header.xml: updated the Glasgow QA example link text to say the GCS score is derived from QuestionnaireResponse answers.
source/observation/list-Observation-examples.xml: updated the Observation examples List description for the Glasgow QA example.
source/observation/observation-example-glasgow-qa.xml: updated XML comments to describe the QuestionnaireResponse derivedFrom source for the score.
